verdict.rationale: Bun's docs say `bun install` writes a text-based `bun.lock`, and that `--frozen-lockfile` installs the exact locked versions without updating the lockfile, explicitly for reproducible installs. A cache-only offline mode adds further determinism. A community report of install crashes concerns stability, not resolved-version drift, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of identical resolutions across machines, and explicit documentation of cross-platform (OS/arch) lockfile determinism.
